title: Product Manager, User Voice AI and Agentic Experiences

label.company_type_evidence: Product company with the seat owning a platform: "Define and execute the product goal and roadmap for the User Feedback ingestion platform". Engineering partners are in Hyderabad, so the seat is co-located with its build team rather than remote from it.
label.why_it_matters: The title says "AI and Agentic Experiences" but the JD is an ingestion-platform and developer-experience role: APIs, pipelines, self-service migration, adoption metrics. Tests that the AI dimension reads the body rather than the title, and that a mislabelled AI role is still scored on its real (strong, platform) shape.
